title: AgentDiff
description: The only data that a coding agent writes for one PR diff. Pair each Before step with the After step that does the same job, by step number in flow order (flow show lists the steps from 1). A step in no pair is new (After) or removed (Before). Write at most one note per cluster on each side: one sentence about what the code now does differently. Do not name cluster renames, merges, or moves. Do not write change kinds, line counts, paths, or digests: code derives them from git.

clusterKey.description: A cluster key of the flow on that side.

text.description: One sentence, starting with what the code does now.
